recorded.prompt:q-evidence: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.

recorded.outcome:q-insurance: Stopped after 50 LP iterations, HiGHS without a start hands back a plan 24% below the optimum on average; with the repaired start, 4.2%.
